issues.on_page: p9 Depreciation Fund 'Transfers from General 490,000'; p5 General Fund 3,589,641 + 15,632,880 - 14,095,479 - 120,000 = 5,007,042 (no 490,000 outflow); p4 General column disbursements 14,227,808 = 14,095,479 + Depreciation 43,116 + Employee Benefit 89,213
issues.issue: One-sided transfer; treating it as a transfer is the extractor's assumption. The arithmetic holds: receipts 17,015,154 + 490,000 = printed 17,505,154 (includes transfers_in), and 5,308,693 + 17,015,154 - 15,474,247 + 490,000 = 7,339,600. No page shows the General Fund paying it out, so no spending line holds the matching outflow. Already in decision_needed[0] and report_discrepancies[0].

issues.on_page: Other local receipts 880,884 (General column 587,331 = General Fund p6 fees 2,994+9,797+25+3,825+9,182+361 = 26,184, plus Depreciation transfer 490,000 (p9), plus Employee Benefit Other Receipts 71,147 (p10); Activities 278,521; Special Building 14,935; Bond 65; QCPU 32)
